name: authai
description: Global trust authority for verifying AI-generated vs human-created content with legally-backed certificates.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd ai-service && python main.py"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && mkdir -p dist && cp -r frontend/out/* dist/
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && cd ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
